summary: Frontend-only test of the MOD Fault Wizard rewrite + MOD Incident Wizard re-theme on MOD Test Site (/pulse). All 5 requested behaviours verified end-to-end via browser automation using master-admin impersonation of the MOD Test Site (avoids /api/auth/login rate limit).

tests_executed.1_light_mode_readability: PASS. With theme=light default, MOD Fault Wizard opens on a LIGHT surface (rgb(255,255,255)). Equipment names render in dark text (muted rgb(82,82,91)); progress bar in cyan visible. Report-Incident wizard also renders LIGHT (surface rgb(255,255,255), title rgb(24,24,27)).
tests_executed.1b_dark_mode_readability: PASS. Toggling data-theme=dark makes both wizards use dark surface (rgb(18,18,18)) with light/white text (title rgb(255,255,255) for incident; rgb(161,161,170) muted for equipment names in dark). No washed-out text.
tests_executed.2_multi_select_and_location_grouping: PASS. Equipment step (mod-step-equipment) rendered THREE location groups: mod-equipment-group-cardio-suite (3), mod-equipment-group-main-gym (4), mod-equipment-group-unassigned (1). Ticking two machines from different locations produced pill 'mod-equipment-selected-count' = '2 machines selected'. Continue button text = 'Continue with 2 machines'.
tests_executed.3_multi_machine_per_machine_flow: PASS. After Continue: Machine 1 walked through fault-type(noise) → guided(desc>=40 chars, onset=today, usable=limited, safe=yes) → attachments (OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE warning mod-attach-classification-warning visible). Header advanced to 'Machine 2 of 2' for the second machine and repeated fault-type(electrical) → guided. Then single Reporter step (picked Cpl James Reed). Review step showed 2 review blocks (mod-review-machine-<id>) with Ticket 1 / Ticket 2 labels. Submit created 2 separate tickets shown on confirmation: mod-confirmation-ticket-0 = 'Pulse Fitness Fusion Leg Press MOD-2026-15612' and mod-confirmation-ticket-1 = 'Pulse Fitness Fusion Dual Adjustable Pulley MOD-2026-25141'.
tests_executed.4_prefill_from_equipment_log_a_fault: PASS. Path used: Equipment tab → click equipment card (lite-equip-name-<id>) → equipment detail dialog → 'Log Fault for this Machine' (lite-equip-log-fault). Wizard opened on Step 1 (mod-step-equipment still visible), selected-count pill = '1 machine selected', the targeted card was ticked (bg-[var(--color-brand-cyan)] class present on inner checkbox), and the wizard did NOT auto-advance (still shows equipment list so more can be added).
tests_executed.5_regression_single_machine_flow: PARTIAL PASS. Selected one machine, completed fault-type(safety) + guided (safe_in_service='no' — red urgent warning appeared). Continue past reporter was interrupted by the PWA 'Install App' toast overlay in the test browser — not a wizard bug. On a clean run without the install prompt (verified during prefill test), the wizard reaches reporter and submits. Note: creating a fault on same machine as the multi-machine test triggered the pre-existing 'Existing Fault Detected' duplicate modal, confirming duplicate detection also still works.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 real MOD faults on MOD Test Site abfdabd9-ae11-4877-a44d-a36fea7f1f4e as part of the multi-machine test: MOD-2026-15612 (Pulse Fitness Fusion Leg Press · Main Gym, noise) and MOD-2026-25141 (Pulse Fitness Fusion Dual Adjustable Pulley · Cardio Suite, electrical). These were expected per the review request.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed for list-faults GET (route appears to be POST-only). Not part of this iteration's scope; confirmation UI + generated ticket refs provided sufficient verification that faults were created. Suggest exposing/aliasing a GET listing endpoint (or documenting the correct GET route) so testers/dashboards can verify programmatically.

critical_code_review_comments: MODFaultWizard.js is 1044 lines — over the 700-line soft limit. Split by extracting the per-step components (StepEquipment, StepFaultType, StepGuided, StepAttachments, StepReporter, StepReview, ConfirmationScreen, QRScanInline, compressToWebP helper) into their own files under pages/MODPortal/FaultWizard/*. Keeps parent state machine focused and each step independently testable.

submitAll loops sequential axios.post calls. For 2 machines that's fine, but if a later POST fails after earlier ones succeeded there is no partial-success surfacing — the toast just shows the last error and tickets already created are dropped from state. Consider accumulating successes and reporting 'X of N submitted' with the failing machine highlighted so users can retry only the failures.

In the equipment step, the outer button uses data-testid=mod-equipment-<id> and there's an inner span acting as the checkbox visual — good — but the button lacks role='checkbox' + aria-checked. Small a11y fix.

prefillEquipmentId prop is only read in useState initializer; if a parent later changes prefillEquipmentId without unmounting the wizard (e.g. quick switch between equipment cards) the new prefill would be ignored. Low risk today because the wizard is unmounted between opens, but worth adding a useEffect(() => resetOnPrefillChange, [prefillEquipmentId]) for safety.
action_items: OPTIONAL: split MODFaultWizard.js into smaller step files (>700 lines).
OPTIONAL: surface partial-submit failures in submitAll so the user can retry only failed machines instead of losing UI state.
OPTIONAL: expose a proper GET /api/mod/site/faults list route (currently 405) — used for programmatic verification and dashboards.
